title: laqte jigar ugalte hai shabbar hussainio
body:
laqte jigar ugalte hai shabbar hussainio
barpa hai ahlebait me mehshar hussainio
jodha ne haaye shaah ko aaqar kiya shaheed
pani ke saath zaher milaakar hussainio
<<DIVIDER>>
kya waaqeya ghazab ka madine me hogaya
hilti hai aaj qabre payambar hussainio
qaasim yateem hota hai bin bhai ke hussain
kehti hai roke zainabe muztar hussainio
<<DIVIDER>>
roohe batool qaak udaati hai laash par
sar peet'te hai faatahe qaibar hussainio
taboot par hassan ke chadhaate hai ashqiya'n
phoolo ke badle teero ki chaadar hussainio
